safety.can.title: What ShelfyGAI Can Do
safety.can.body: ShelfyGAI can hide ordinary top-level application windows from the taskbar and Alt+Tab by changing reversible Windows extended styles. The apps keep running in memory and can be restored from ShelfyGAI.
safety.cannot.title: What ShelfyGAI Cannot Do
safety.cannot.body: ShelfyGAI does not terminate apps, suspend processes, bypass Windows permissions, manage secure desktop prompts, or force unsupported windows to behave like normal taskbar apps.
safety.why.title: Why Some Windows Cannot Be Managed
safety.why.body: Windows shell surfaces, the taskbar, Start Menu, ShelfyGAI itself, protected system windows, owned utility windows, tool windows, and elevated apps from a non-elevated ShelfyGAI instance are blocked to keep the desktop recoverable.
safety.restore.title: How To Restore Safely
safety.restore.body: Use Restore or Restore All from the Hidden windows page or tray menu. If an app closed while hidden, ShelfyGAI removes the stale entry safely. Keep restore-on-exit enabled for the safest shutdown behavior.
recovery.description: ShelfyGAI found a recovery file from a previous session. It will restore still-existing hidden windows and safely ignore stale entries.
